author: Para_Dice
body:
Hello people of avicus! Today we have a map called Stop Bugging Me. It is a Destroy The Monument map.
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/9grnbnzplm9li7n/Thunder2.rar
Images: http://imgur.com/a/iDZjm
YML: by Tiger coding: http://pastebin.com/U2bGnqyJ
Sorry if the links didn't work. They never do with me xD
The teams are: Bees vs Ladybugs


There are 2 monuments: 1 is named nest, and the other one is named flower.

Spawn Items: Iron sword (1), Bow (1), Arrows (infinity), Gold apples (3), Oak wood (32), Oak leaves (32), Potatos (16), Iron axe (1), Nebula shop (1)




Anyways, that will be all for the map. I hope it gets accepted




Oh and thanks SweetMango for supplying the build server.



And special thanks to TigerCoding for doing the YML, screenshots, and the video http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3wvtmPV3J1q . Thank you TigerCoding.

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Island size. The size of each island is way too small. This causes users to be easily knocked off the ledge. There is also very little space for pvping. 
→ Void space. Islands are too far apart from one another. To fix this, you can either add more islands or expand the islands present in the map currently

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: Have you even played those maps? Rendezvous sees quite some pvp on the 2 rushing lanes. Luar has the main bridge, the front islands and sky bridging action. Frostbite....I don't even know what to say...it's a big map. There's tons of space. Broken world consists of different islands spread out across the map, therefore increasing the space. While some of these maps might not be the biggest or the best, they are all decent sized, have good monument placing and unique tactics
